entries.title: Hybrid fusion no worse
entries.model: On a seeded known-item recall sample of the work_item and session_turn sources of search:semantic, drawn from the live dev-box operator database (at least 60 queries per source, keyword and verbatim-fragment styles), hybrid fused recall@10 with the BM25 lexical leg (BM25 list plus the D-016 gated exact list) is at least the hybrid fused recall@10 with the pre-swap legacy leg (BM25 flag off), per source, on the identical sample in the same run.
entries.method:
packages/operator-core/lib/search/bench/bm25-hybrid-recall-cli.ts --pairs 60 against the dev-box operator database through an explicit DSN (HARNESS_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL, as the operator unit sets it). The CLI records the server port, server version and pg_textsearch version, refuses to measure when the BM25 arm is unavailable, samples one identical pair set for both arms, runs both arms per pair in one process alternating which goes first, and writes identity-redacted queries. The memory store is out of scope: its lexical leg is lexicalSearchCanonical, not BM25, so the flag cannot change it  (D-017). The bound fusion suite checks the RRF arithmetic and the exact-list merge. Evidence: the tracked manifest docs/evidence/bm25-r18-qualification-2026-10-12.json, to be created and recorded as a plan Decision BEFORE the first judged run, declaring the three prospectively selected seed ids, frozen committed root and submodule revisions, executed SHA-256 set, registered embedding profile and three exact artifact paths; artifacts are bound via testing:record-run. No older artifact qualifies by itself. Decisions D-004, D-006, D-016, D-017. Coverage: this bar covers the work_item and session_turn sources only. The other BM25-ranked search:semantic sources (plans, documents, coord posts, decisions, escalations, brainstorm; D-017 "Not covered") are unmeasured here and owned by WI-6554700010008535; a grade on this bar is not a claim about them. D-032 replaces the exact/BM25 merge with BM25-first interleaving, deduplicated by corpus identity: exact rank r appears by position 2r, BM25 rank r by position 2r-1. D-033 materializes one cap+1 exact candidate scan, checks the unchanged cap 5,000, ranks by the same ts_rank_cd, and hydrates top rows by their complete database key. The real fusion integration suite also verifies the cap boundary, skips over-cap ranking, and checks cross-workspace hydration with an exact-only target; a copy-out partial-key mutant must fail that guard. R-13 is required on each of the three consecutive prospective instrumented runs judged by R-18; any failure restarts the sequence. Evidence uses the tracked manifest docs/evidence/bm25-r18-qualification-2026-10-12.json, to be created and recorded as a plan Decision BEFORE the first judged run, declaring the three prospectively selected seed ids, frozen committed root and submodule revisions, executed SHA-256 set, registered embedding profile and three exact artifact paths; artifacts are bound via testing:record-run. D-017 coverage exclusions remain unchanged.

D-035/D-036/D-039 qualification supplement: retained D033 passes are historical and never substitute for prospective clean-source proof. The named tracked manifest and exact artifact paths identify the new series; all d033, qualified and hybrid-provenance series remain historical. Record the immutable committed root and submodule revisions, clean tracked source state before and after each run, and SHA-256 for the executed CLI, pure benchmark, hybrid engine, RRF engine, lexical ranker and source registry; changing any executed source byte resets the sequence. Use the original registered query embedder with the cached query vector; record its exact embedding profile and per-arm semantic candidate contribution, and refuse unknown embedding provenance. D-039 preserves the best original 1-based ordinal from the correlated BM25/exact alternatives through final RRF as one lexical vote; interleaved admission position is not a second relevance penalty. The maintained full runHybridSearch regression in packages/operator-core/lib/search/bench/bm25-hybrid-recall.test.ts must reproduce the D038 exact-rank-three/no-semantic-target case: its pre-fix behavior misses and repaired behavior retrieves the target. The existing cap, full-key hydration, partial-key mutation guard, same-sample comparison and source coverage exclusions remain required. No changed recall floor, candidate cap, corpus, sample selection or reset rule.

Exact maintained cases: bm25-hybrid-recall.test.ts 'keeps the D038 exact rank-three target through final hybrid fusion, with a real semantic list' and 'keeps the registered embedding space in both arms while computing each query once'; these exercise the old missing-ordinal and unknown-profile controls versus repaired retrieval. Source qualification is machine checked by the maintained bm25-hybrid-recall.test.ts cases rejecting dirty executed files, changed source bytes/frozen manifest hash mismatches, a submodule HEAD differing from its parent gitlink, failed Git probes, missing repository witnesses, dropped mandatory sources, reused seeds and unsafe paths. Those are D-041/D-049 detectors; a passing guard is a prerequisite and never a qualifying benchmark seed.

entries.title: Fusion depends on rank, never on a raw BM25 score
entries.model: Every fusion of a lexical leg with a cosine leg over one corpus, and every merge of best-first lists from different corpora, depends only on in-list position (reciprocal rank, k = 60), so rescaling any leg's scores changes no fused order.
entries.method:
Unit tests of fuseByPosition and an integration test of rrfTerm on a real pg_textsearch server, each rescaling one leg and asserting the order is unchanged. Decisions D-004, D-006.

D-039 ordinal supplement: the optional RankedItem.fusionRank carries the best original 1-based rank of a document in the correlated exact/BM25 alternatives; the alternatives supply one lexical vote. Final RRF uses that original ordinal plus any existing rankOffset, instead of penalizing its interleaved admission position again. Items with an omitted optional ordinal retain index+1 behavior; an explicitly provided invalid ordinal is rejected. Verify ordinal validation and offset arithmetic in libs/generic/rrf/src/index.test.ts and the full runHybridSearch D038 regression in packages/operator-core/lib/search/bench/bm25-hybrid-recall.test.ts ('keeps the D038 exact rank-three target through final hybrid fusion, with a real semantic list'), retaining the D032 high-overlap rank-one guard and the existing raw-score rescaling/cross-corpus tests. This extends the existing rank-only seam; no raw native score or duplicate alternative vote may enter fusion.

entries.title: Search path latency bounded
entries.model: Across three consecutive prospectively named, instrumented runs with at least 60 paired queries for each work_item and session_turn source from the live dev-box operator database, each source meets the complete three-clause R-18 hybrid-latency envelope defined in METHOD under the R-13 recall prerequisite and reset-on-failure rule.
entries.method:
Run packages/operator-core/lib/search/bench/bm25-hybrid-recall-cli.ts --pairs 60 with explicit HARNESS_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL pointing to the recorded native server. Declare three distinct seeds before any judged run. Per source sample disjoint P/W/S target-and-query sets of 60 each. Precompute every timed query embedding once before timing  (D-021); record embeddingsPrecomputed=true. The cold pass times legacy and BM25 on identical P pairs in one process, alternating arm order; judges same-run relative bound (D-019) and cold ceiling (D-029). Warm-repeat pass over P calls BM25 once untimed immediately before its timed BM25 call; judges200/400ms ceilings (D-020/D-028). Later W warm-up and S novel steady pass remain diagnostic only, never substitute for the judged repeat. Judge with judgeLatency and warmRepeatProblems in bm25-hybrid-recall.ts. Require all clauses and R-13 on three consecutive instrumented runs (D-031); preserve every failed/invalid result, reset after failure or code change, never seed-chase. Per-call sampler freezes at search completion before cleanup, records setup/cleanup and scheduler boundary skew, excludes boundary-crossing waits, marks partial backend CPU coverage; shared pg_stat_statements attribution cannot be assigned to an own call. Host waits/scheduler/pgss and dump overlap are diagnostic, never waive the bars or by themselves establish a resource cause. Existing unit suite pins p95, both ceiling sets, invalid arms/repeats, disjoint samples, and measurement boundaries. Evidence: the tracked manifest docs/evidence/bm25-r18-qualification-2026-10-12.json, to be created and recorded as a plan Decision BEFORE the first judged run, declaring the three prospectively selected seed ids, frozen committed root and submodule revisions, executed SHA-256 set, registered embedding profile and three exact artifact paths; artifacts are bound via testing:record-run. Each artifact records fields verdict, latencyVerdict, sampleFingerprint, seed, sources[].latency, warmPairs, warmRepeatPass and attribution via testing:record-run(operational, live plane). The source/test proofs must be reproducible; a dirty local run is not a formal binding. R-2 remains the 50 ms lexical engine-query budget; R-18 bounds the full hybrid path including exact list and final highlights. Decisions D-016,D-019,D-020,D-021,D-028,D-029,D-030,D-031,D-032,D-033. The absolute ceilings were moved from cold to warm-repeat after observed cold failures; this measurement-method change requires outside-lineage review, and retained cold absolute bounds prevent a slow legacy baseline from greenwashing a slow BM25 cold path. Explicit envelope definition, unchanged from the approved preview: cold paired BM25 p95 must be no greater than same-run legacy p95 and no greater than 1,000 ms for work_item or 1,200 ms for session_turn, and warm-repeat BM25 p95 must be no greater than 200 ms for work_item or 400 ms for session_turn. Every clause and R-13 must pass on every run in the three-run prospective sequence; failure, invalidity or a code change resets it.

D-035/D-036/D-040 qualification supplement: use the tracked docs/evidence/bm25-r18-qualification-2026-10-12.json and its exact artifact paths, declared before the first judged run; retained d033 artifacts remain historical, and the qualifying count is currently zero after D038. Before another judged sequence, verify current committed source and test bytes through the maintained suites, verify usable test/benchmark artifact capacity without deleting unowned artifacts or splitting the shared dependency mutex, confirm the explicit database and exact registered embedding profile, and audit retained failures for both recall loss and serial retrieval stages. D-040 starts independent semantic source retrieval as soon as its query vector settles, concurrently with lexical retrieval; fusion still records inputs in deterministic lexical-then-semantic order. The maintained pending-lexical/started-semantic guard in libs/generic/search/src/hybrid.test.ts must pass along with hybrid-cascade, cancellation/degradation, rank, RRF, pure benchmark and real-PG fusion suites; its finally releases the delayed lexical gate. Run an unjudged saved-query/tail diagnostic before qualification, preserving original targets, profile and relevant source hashes. Record clean source state and executed SHA-256 before/after every judged run, including root/submodule commits; a post-run HEAD alone does not identify executed dirty bytes. Registered provenance, cold/relative/warm ceilings, R-13 prerequisite, instrumentation boundaries, all failures and the prospective three-run/reset rule remain unchanged. Stage overlap addresses serial elapsed-time addition; it does not establish a fix for underlying per-block read latency or waive any ceiling.

Case identity and remaining preconditions: hybrid.test.ts 'starts semantic retrieval while the independent lexical query is still pending'; benchmark test 'keeps the registered embedding space in both arms while computing each query once'. The automatic qualification detectors in bm25-hybrid-recall.test.ts reject dirty executed files, changed hashes, submodule/gitlink mismatch, failed Git probes, missing witnesses, reduced mandatory sources, repeated seeds and identity leaks (D-041/D-049). Each guard must have current source-qualified proof before qualification; guard proof does not count toward the prospective three-seed outcome. Earlier d033, qualified and hybrid-provenance series are historical. Stage durations are attribution only and do not sum to call latency after overlap; use recorded stage start/end intervals for any measured overlap claim, otherwise make no such attribution.

Inverse trace: D-046/D-047/D-048 select and correct per-surface chunk-HNSW indexes as latency remediation; their graded acceptance consequence in this BAR is the unchanged cold/relative/warm latency envelope, not the existence of an index. Native and desktop migration acceptance remains separately owed on WI-10005483. Historical run/attribution decisions D-027/D-030/D-037/D-038/D-043/D-044/D-045 supply diagnosis and failed evidence, not independent outcome bars. D-024/D-025 are retracted by D-026. Amendment/process decisions D-015/D-018/D-022/D-034/D-042 do not add outcome semantics.

Inverse trace through current D-052 (plan version 80, 52 decisions): D-050 repairs R-1/R-5/R-11/R-12 operational detector bindings and R-15 docs-search coverage; these criteria grade their unchanged outcomes. D-051 corrects maintenance size estimation; R-7 still uses actual own-REINDEX bytes. D-052 extends production reclaim eligibility to small indexes; D-013 every-index soak acceptance remains required by R-14 before retirement. These decisions add no new waived scope or threshold; current proof must reflect changed source bytes, and no historical failure becomes a pass.
entries.driftMarkers: BROKEN if any of the three consecutive prospective runs fails R-13 or is invalid, or on either source (1) cold paired BM25 p95 exceeds same-run legacy p95; (2) cold paired p95 exceeds 1,000 ms work_item or 1,200 ms session_turn; (3) warm-repeat p95 exceeds 200 ms work_item or 400 ms session_turn; (4) a timed query was not pre-embedded or the two arms were not measured on identical pairs in one process; (5) a warm-repeat lacks a BM25 observation, its untimed immediately preceding call, or its validity/latency verdict; (6) a failed result is discarded, a replacement seed selected after seeing a result, or code changes during the qualifying sequence. Record every result and reset the count after a failure or code change.
